# Expected RLS policy set, generated by rebuilding migrations/ into an empty database.
#
# One line per policy: tablename|policyname|cmd|roles|Q=<qual>|C=<with_check>, with runs
# of whitespace inside the predicates collapsed to one space. "-" means the column is
# NULL (a policy with no USING or no WITH CHECK).
#
# This file is the shared artifact for the two halves of the drift check:
#   - rlsPolicyDrift.db.test.ts pins the MIGRATION side: any migration that adds, drops
#     or reshapes a policy fails the DB suite until this file is regenerated, so the
#     change shows up in a diff and has to be deliberate.
#   - scripts/sql/rls_drift_check.sql pins the DEPLOYED side: run it against production
#     to find policies that exist there and in no migration, or the reverse.
#
# The test alone cannot see production. That was the gap 042 closed: migrations/ built
# 64 policies while production held 81, and CI stayed green throughout because it only
# ever asserted that RLS was enabled.
#
# Regenerate after any policy change:
#   psql "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" -At -f scripts/sql/rls_policy_dump.sql > scripts/sql/rls_policy_inventory.txt
#
academic_sessions|academic_sessions_tenant_isolation|ALL|public|Q=(school_id = ((auth.jwt() ->> 'school_id'::text))::uuid)|C=(school_id = ((auth.jwt() ->> 'school_id'::text))::uuid)
academic_sessions|service_role_bypass|ALL|service_role|Q=true|C=true
